slides.title: A drone strike reportedly hit a school
slides.body: Sana Elementary School, Dera district, South Gondar zone, Amhara

slides.title: schoolchildren reported killed
slides.body: on Tuesday, Oct 20, around 10 a.m., with classes in session, Borkena reported, citing Anchor Media and EMS.

slides.title: others reported wounded
slides.body: and taken to hospital. Their condition was not given. The figures have not been independently verified.

slides.title: The account is disputed
slides.body: Reports attributed the strike to the federal military. Pro-government social media accounts claimed it targeted Fano fighters and no children died. The government and army have not commented.

slides.title: Protect schools and civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Borkena (citing Anchor Media, EMS), Oct 21, 2026
